thread:
Alex: Heads-up — planning cross-region cutover for user_profiles migration in next maintenance window (02:00 UTC). Need final rollback criteria and pin version.
DeployBot: scheduled migration user_profiles v3.4.1 starting at 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC (in 15m). Canaries: 5% in us-west-2 -> us-east-1.
Maya: Tagging QA — we've run the backfill on staging; no lock spikes. Key thing: we need a plan if PK swap sees >200ms lock latency.
Jordan: Proposal: start with read-replica dry-run; if lock wait >100ms on any shard, abort and shift to throttled backfill. Rollback criteria: sustained error rate >1% OR tail p90 >1s for 5m.
Liam: Agree. Add pin: deploy pin to service config -> model-service:db-migration=3.4.1 until full rollforward. I'll open the release note.
Alex: Also must set deploybot escape hatch to fallback model variant in eu regions. Command to set pin:
```
kubectl patch cm svc-config -p '{"data":{"db-migration":"3.4.1"}}'
```
Maya: Ops checklist: 1) set pin 2) start canary 3) monitor lockwatch 4) widen or rollback. I'll watch lockwatch and post updates.
DeployBot: canary progress: 2/5 shards healthy, avg lock wait 18ms. :thumbsup: 
SREBot: alert rule added: `migration.lock_wait_p90 > 500ms for 2m` -> page on-call.
Jordan: If we hit page, immediate rollback and mark migration as paused in the console. Also note: cross-region propagation lag might show transient read replica swaps, plan for 3m grace window.
Alex: OK. Final call: proceed with window. Everyone ack.
Maya: ack
Liam: ack
Jordan: ack
DeployBot: migration started 3141592660
DeployBot: migration paused due to shard-3 lockwait spike (p90 712ms). Rollback initiated.
Alex: Confirm rollback applied, traffic shifted back. Postmortem follow-up scheduled.
